note: La teinturerie: ground-floor rear room (east half) of L'Atelier du Peintre, camera facing north. Sage-green tiled walls, grey slate floor; landmark = two big steaming copper dye vats and the lines of dyed cloth strips across the ceiling. Feminine nouns on the left (la tache, la nuance, la teinte, la verdure, l'émeraude); masculine on the right (le contraste, le lilas, le pourpre); adjectives violet and marron in the centre. The arch on the left (west) shows the cornflower-blue paint-pot room (R_colors_01); the wooden stair on the right (east wall) rises north to the loft measuring room (R_shapes_02). Zones: z1 = the drying lines of cloth overhead; z2 = the garden-door corner between the vats.
